description: Source code for the icrule module, including functions for parsing XML rules, managing rule components, and handling time slots and triggers.

methods.name: parse_xmldoc
methods.description: Parses an XML document to initialize an icrule_t structure, loading actions, triggers, constraints, schedule, and description.

methods.name: icrule_parse
methods.description: Parses an XML string to populate an icrule_t structure.

methods.name: icrule_parse_file
methods.description: Parses an XML file to populate an icrule_t structure.

methods.name: icrule_destroy
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an icrule_t structure and its components.

methods.name: parse_exact_time
methods.description: Converts a time string in hours:minutes format to total seconds.

methods.name: parse_day_of_week
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of day abbreviations into a bitmask.

methods.name: icrule_parse_time_slot
methods.description: Parses an XML node to extract time slot information, including exact time and day of week.

methods.name: strtok2list
methods.description: Splits a string into a linked list of tokens based on delimiters.
